publisher_acm.method: Resolve each annual main research proceedings volume via DBLP DOI links; enumerate publisher table of contents; exclude companion, demo, short, workshop, front matter. Research papers in journal-integrated proceedings need event mappings.

publisher_ieee.method: Resolve each annual research-proceedings volume from DBLP; enumerate full regular research papers only. Separate companion/workshop/poster volumes.

publisher_springer.method: Resolve all annual LNCS/LNAI main-proceedings parts from DBLP; enumerate research chapters, excluding prefaces, keynotes without full papers, indexes and ancillary tracks.

dblp.method: Use DBLP as a discovery and reconciliation layer, not an unfiltered denominator. Conference indexes can include workshops and journal-integrated tracks. Paginate searches; API hit caps and title-only searches cannot establish exhaustiveness.

excluded_examples.note: This is a CCF-A conference scope, not a ranking of medical-conference relevance.

paper_scope.include: Full or regular research papers in eligible conference tracks; explicitly tag any additional full-paper special tracks. Main-track-only view should be the default for comparable ratios.
paper_scope.deduplication: DOI first, then normalized title + author + event; one paper may have multiple source links but one record.
paper_scope.year_rule: Conference edition year; explicitly map journal-first/event-integrated papers instead of using calendar publication year.

core: Biomedical signals and clinically motivated wearable sensing
Public health, epidemiology and disease surveillance
Medical devices, surgery, rehabilitation and assistive health technology
biomedical_adjacent: Drug discovery and molecular design with an explicit therapeutic objective
Human disease genomics and biological mechanisms
Protein or molecular modelling with explicit biomedical validation
exclude_or_review: Generic protein/molecule prediction without a medical objective
Generic fairness/privacy paper with one incidental health benchmark
Human activity, emotion or wellbeing sensing without an explicit health objective
Medical mentions only in future-work or motivation
medical_definition.screening_rule: Title/keyword search is candidate generation only. Review abstracts and, when ambiguous, full text; retain evidence snippets and inclusion/exclusion reason. Tag core vs adjacent and allow readers to filter.

statistics.within_conference_share: 100 × included medical full papers / all eligible full papers in the same conference-year and track scope. Show unavailable, not 0, until both inventories are complete.
statistics.medical_distribution_share: 100 × medical papers at this conference / all medical papers in the current filtered corpus. Label as corpus share, not within-conference share.
statistics.popularity: Prefer timestamped citation count from a named source, with a year-normalized alternative; never invent view/bookmark counts or confuse local clicks with scholarly impact.
statistics.completeness: This file establishes the venue universe and routes only. It does not claim any conference-year has been exhaustively screened. None of the denominators have been counted in this audit.

source_notes.finding: Official index explicitly notes datasets-and-benchmarks papers join main proceedings from 2022; classify tracks explicitly.
